3167 *kiyatta 'how great?'. [~ kíyant- as iyattaká- RV. ~ iyant-]
    Pa. kittaka- 'how much or many?', Pk. kittiya-, Ash. ċīt, Wg. kiti; Paš. dar. weg. kuti 'anything'; Gaw. kata 'how many?', Bshk. kīte, Phal. katī, K. kūtᵘ, dat. kṳ̄tis, pl. kaitⁱ, kash. kyutŭ; L. kittĩ 'how much?', awāṇ. kittī 'how many?'; P. kitt 'what?'; A. ketek 'how much?', H. kittā, kitā; M. kitĩ 'how much?', kitī 'how many?', Si. ketek (or ke + tek 'up to'?). — Ext. with -n-: P. H. kitnā, L. P. bhaṭ. kitṇā; — with -r-: L. kitrā, OMarw. kītarāka; — with -l-: L. kittlā.
    Addenda: *kiyatta-: S.kcch. kitrī 'how much?', kitrāk 'how many?', WPah.kc. ketri; kṭg. (kc.) ketti 'how much? how many? some'; kṭg. ketrɔ, kc. ketṇo 'how much?', G. keṭlī, pl. keṭlāk, Md. kitak.

3271.html:
3271 kútaḥ 'whence?' RV., 'where?' R. [ka¹-]
    Pa. kutō 'whence?', Aś. dh. jau. kute, Pk. kuō; Kho. kur 'where?'.
    Addenda: kútaḥ: Kho. *kur in kurā 'where', na kurā 'nowhere', kuri 'whither' with loc. suffix -ā or -i BKhoT 70; S.kcch. ko 'why?'.

2528.html:
2528 ēvam ēva 'just so' AitBr. [ēvá¹]
    Pa. ēvamēva, Aś. shah. man. kāl. evameva, kāl. hevameva, dh. jau. hemeva, NiDoc. emeva, emu, ema; Pk. ēvamēva, ēmēva, ēmēa, ēmia, Ap. emva, emvaï, ēma, ēuṁji 'just so', emvahiṁ, evvahi 'now', P. aivẽ, ivẽ, aiũ, aĩ 'in this way', OAw. imi, lakh. ewaĩ, H. im, OG. ima, G. εm (i emphasized as ε); Si. (inscr.) meva, mevu, mē, later -ma 'enclitic particle of emphasis' (EGS 125 < ēvá¹).
    Addenda: ēvam ēva: Md. -me emphatic enclitic.
    Ap. emvahĩ, evvahĩ, evahĩ: WPah.kṭg. εbbε 'now', kc. ebe; kṭg. ébbhi 'immediately', kc. ebi; OA. ewe 'now', ebho (< ēvam ēva khalu?) AFD 325, OMarw. hiva Vīsaḷa p. 159, OG. hiva(i), hivaḍā̃; — poss. X adhunā́: OG. hivaṇā̃.
    X pron. a-: Pk.amg. havvaṁ 'now', WPah.kc. abe, OA. āwe, H. ab, abhī, OG. hava(i), havaḍā̃.
    X ká-²: WPah.kṭg. kεbε 'when?', kc. kebia, kabhia, kabia 'sometimes, ever'; B. kabe, H. kab 'when?', kabhī 'ever'.
    X tá-: WPah.kṭg. tεbbε 'then', kc. tabe, kṭg. tébbhi 'immediately', kc. tebi, OA. tāwe, tebe, tewe, B. tabe, H. tab, tabhī.
    X yá-: WPah.kṭg. j̈εbbε 'when', kc. j̈abe, kṭg. j̈ebbhi, kc. j̈ebi, OA. jebe, jewe, jāwe, H. jab, jabhī.

3384.html:
3384 kúha 'where?' RV. [ka-¹]
    Pk. kuha, Ash. kū̃, Phal. gō, Si. ko; — altern. NIA. words < kvà, Pa. kuva: but direct derivation is unlikely.
    Addenda: kúha [< *kudha cf. Ir. Shgh. kād < *kudā EVSh 40]
